hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is recovered as the divided difference of F(z)=s(z) over the ordered node multiset: G0001 = DD_{p,q}[s], G0002 = DD_{p,p}[s] (confluent first-derivative limit), G0003 = DD_{p,p,q}[s].
required_assumptions: s is differentiable at p for the confluent node pair p,p
F(z)=s(z) is sufficiently smooth for Hermite divided differences
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The expressions are structurally unified by Hermite divided differences of the declared univariate function s: G0001 is the first divided difference on distinct nodes p and q, G0002 is the confluent first divided difference on repeated node p, and G0003 is the second divided difference on node multiset p,p,q. This explains the non-identical members through one latent function and explicit node-multiplicity operators.
